camel_example: aliyun cloud-siem DeleteBindAccount --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --AccountId 123xxxxxxx --AccessId ABCXXXXXXXX --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Unbinds a multi-cloud (Tencent Cloud or Huawei Cloud) sub-account AccessKey that is bound to the threat analysis data source module. After unbinding, you can bind a different account
description_zh: 解除已经绑定到威胁分析数据源模块的多云（腾讯云、华为云）子账号AK，解绑后可以更换账号重新绑定
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem delete-bind-account --account-id 123xxxxxxx --access-id ABCXXXXXXXX --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBindAccount

parameters.help_en: The binding ID. You can call ListBindAccount (https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854&activeTabKey=api|ListBindAccount) to obtain the binding ID
parameters.name: bind_id

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID of the cloud account
parameters.name: access_id

parameters.help_en:
The code of the multi-cloud provider. Valid values:

qcloud: Tencent Cloud.
aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.
hcloud: Huawei Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
qcloud：腾讯云。
aliyun：阿里云。
hcloud：华为云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Select the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets belong to the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Your assets belong to regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

Count.description_en: The number of deleted account bindings. A value of 1 indicates success. A value less than or equal to 0 indicates failure
Count.description_zh: 删除账号绑定的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败
Count.title_zh: 删除账号绑定的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败。
